fixture: 100 rapid synthetic progress and title updates in two bursts
limitations: The repaint calls are measured for two deliberately rapid synthetic bursts; actual tasks have different timing and real device refreshes need not match these counts.
Repeated old repaints darken a few antialiased corner pixels; content pixels match, but screenshots are not wholly identical.
Desktop emulation does not measure physical screen latency, ghosting, power or Kindle battery life.
